name: Band Clamshell

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: APTA Hip Strengthening and Alignment Guidelines

steps: Place a small resistance loop band around both thighs, resting just above your knees.
Lie on your side with hips bent at 45 degrees, knees bent at 90 degrees, and feet stacked together.
Engage your core to prevent your lower back or pelvis from rolling backward.
Open your top knee against the resistance of the band while keeping your feet touching.
Hold for one second at peak contraction, then lower slowly resisting the pull of the band.
coaching_cues: Choose a light-to-medium band that allows full range of motion without compensating.
Control the descent; do not allow the band to snap your knees together.
Breathe out as you open and breathe in as you close.
